WITH PREV_WEEK AS (
SELECT YEAR,WEEKOFYEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y'
GROUP BY
YEAR,WEEKOFYEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
),
PREV_MONTH AS (
SELECT YEAR,MONTH,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y'
GROUP BY
YEAR,MONTH,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
),
PREV_YEAR AS (
SELECT YEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,MAX(DATESK) LATEST_BDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y'
GROUP BY
YEAR,BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG
)


SELECT DD.DATESK,COALESCE(PW.LATEST_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE) PREV_WEEK_BDATE,COALESCE(PM.LATEST_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE) PREV_MONTH_BDATE,PY.LATEST_BDATE PREV_YEAR_BDATE FROM EDS.DATE_DIM DD 
LEFT JOIN PREV_WEEK PW
ON (DATEPART(WEEK,DD.FULLDATE)-1)=PW.WEEKOFYEAR AND PW.YEAR=DD.YEAR
LEFT JOIN PREV_MONTH PM
ON (DATEPART(MONTH,DD.FULLDATE)-1)=PM.MONTH AND PM.YEAR=DD.YEAR
LEFT JOIN PREV_YEAR PY
ON (DATEPART(YEAR,DD.FULLDATE)-1)=PY.YEAR 
--WHERE DATESK IN ('20110101','20110102')
ORDER BY DATESK
